name: california
title: California (default scenario)

preset.note: original data of the paper (Li et al., HPEC 2025), imported once by scripts/casestudies/import_california.py; chargers are the original 25 stations, not merged

road_network.source: OpenStreetMap (Geofabrik California extract), motorway..primary, for plotting only; the shipped california_hgv_mw-tr-pr-se.osm is truncated GraphML

vehicle_model.note: energy model of the original data is not documented in the repository

route_policy: minimum battery energy on the original network; negative-energy pairs are excluded by the environment

sources.energy_time_network_stations: Li et al. (HPEC 2025) California logistics network as shipped in EVRoutingEnv/data
sources.terrain: AWS Terrain Tiles (Terrarium; USGS 3DEP/NED), only for node elevation and plotted road grade
